mapper.sql: SELECT p.id, b.account_id, p.name, p.gender, p.age, b.relation, b.is_default, p.updated_at FROM consult_account_patient b JOIN consult_person p ON p.id = b.person_id AND p.is_deleted = 0
mapper.select: SELECT id, mobile, status FROM consult_account WHERE mobile = #{mobile} AND is_deleted = 0
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO consult_account (id, mobile, status, created_at, updated_at, is_deleted) VALUES (#{id}, #{mobile}, 1, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3), CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3), 0)
mapper.select: WHERE b.account_id = #{accountId} AND b.is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY b.is_default DESC, b.created_at ASC
WHERE b.account_id = #{accountId} AND b.person_id = #{personId} AND b.is_deleted = 0
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM consult_account_patient WHERE account_id = #{accountId} AND is_deleted = 0

SELECT a.id, a.mobile, a.status, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM consult_account_patient b WHERE b.account_id = a.id AND b.is_deleted = 0) AS person_count, DATE_FORMAT(a.created_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS created_at FROM consult_account a WHERE a.is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY a.created_at DESC LIMIT 200
mapper.sql: SELECT p.id, b.account_id, a.mobile, p.name, p.gender, p.age, b.relation, b.is_default FROM consult_account_patient b JOIN consult_person p ON p.id = b.person_id AND p.is_deleted = 0 JOIN consult_account a ON a.id = b.account_id AND a.is_deleted = 0 WHERE b.is_deleted = 0
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO consult_person (id, name, gender, age, created_at, updated_at, is_deleted) VALUES (#{id}, #{name}, #{gender}, #{age}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3), CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3), 0)
